summary: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K attaching notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement for an October 9, 2026 meeting. Shareholders will vote on a group restructuring: VSM Holdings transfers VS MEDIA PTE. LTD. to Aurenza Group Limited, then the Company sells all VSM shares to an unaffiliated third party for US$1.00, disposing of loss-making businesses. A second proposal adopts amended articles renaming the Company Forcendra Holding Limited and introducing Class B redemption rights. The board recommends approval. Watch for shareholder dissent and post-restructuring stub value.
